concept: Review and integration: service as a genuine practice, not a resume line
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across sustained commitment, understanding real needs, and serving without recognition — what's most honest about your own motivations?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real ongoing way to serve that fits their actual life

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
